name: Beware
description: Two weeks in Jude: beware of knockoffs, contend for the faith once for all entrusted to the saints, and defend it with mercy.
note: Josh opens the series by announcing two weeks in the book of Jude.

provenance.detail: The official Beware playlist includes Fight for Truth.
Josh says, “over the next two weeks we’re going to be looking at the book of Jude.”
The official Beware playlist includes Merciful Defenders.
